# Return contract — `verification`

<!-- Generated by generate_agent_definitions.py; do not edit. -->
<!-- delivery-version: 083eb1bc1a0c628b2d6d48b806b6568be3f67ac2 2026-11-07T12:31:37+01:00 -->

Return a JSON object with `status`, `decisions`, `read_receipts`, and `missing_evidence`, plus `refusals`.
Each decision carries `candidate_id`, `decision` (exactly `verified`, `rejected`, or `unverified`), `reason`, `severity`, `severity_reason`, `missing_evidence`, and `read_receipts`.
Preserve proposed severity unless the demonstrated consequence and scope justify a change, and explain any change.
An unresolved material precondition requires `unverified`.
Identify the security exception explicitly; a proven pre-existing observation retains its earlier source and never changes the verdict.
If no candidate was assigned and no evidence is missing, return `status: complete`, `decisions: []`, and `empty_result: NO_FINDINGS`.
Incomplete, truncated, or refused work cannot use that token; a refusal returns `status: refused` with `refusals` populated.
